verdict.rationale: Modal ships an official Python SDK with detailed reference docs for Sandbox, Probe and SandboxSnapshot plus release notes. It also ships official JS and Go SDKs on GitHub, with a guide and code samples for creating sandboxes, mounting volumes and running exec. Missing for 10: the JS/Go SDKs cover only 'some' platform resources compared with Python, and there is no independent hands-on corroboration of building against the SDKs (the community items describe projects on Modal Sandboxes and gRPC control, not SDK usage).
